This capability breaks down language barriers in supplier negotiations and sourcing conversations, enabling the company to maintain the high-quality sourcing standards it has upheld for nearly a century.
overview.zh: 創立於 1929 年的家族特色食品零售商 Nuts.com 使用 Google Meet 中 Gemini 的即時翻譯功能，與全球供應商無縫溝通。此功能消除供應商談判與採購對話中的語言障礙，讓公司得以維持近百年來堅守的高品質採購標準。

en: Uses Gemini live translation in Google Meet for real-time multilingual supplier communications.
Breaks down language barriers to maintain high-quality global sourcing since 1929.
Enables seamless supplier negotiations without the need for human translators.
zh: 使用 Google Meet 中的 Gemini 即時翻譯功能，進行即時多語言供應商溝通。
消除語言障礙，維持自 1929 年以來的高品質全球採購標準。
無需人工翻譯即可進行無縫的供應商談判。

A key benefit is that users can automate mundane and repetitive tasks independently, without waiting for IT projects, significantly reducing operational friction and accelerating internal process improvements.

en: Automates meeting notetaking and summarization using Gemini in Google Workspace.
Empowers users to automate repetitive tasks independently, without IT project dependencies.
Customizes workflows to reduce operational friction across the online grocery business.

賦能使用者自主自動化重複性任務，無需依賴 IT 專案。
客製化工作流程，減少線上超市業務的營運阻力。

Helps the CEO manage dual demands of running a business and raising three children.
Demonstrates AI tools enabling small business founders to operate more efficiently.

協助 CEO 同時應對經營企業與照顧三個孩子的雙重需求。
展現 AI 工具如何協助小型企業創辦人更有效率地運作。

summary.en: Europe's largest retailer Schwarz Group (Lidl, Kaufland) partners with Google to deploy sovereign Google Workspace for 575,000 employees via STACKIT.
summary.zh: 歐洲最大零售商 Schwarz Group（含 Lidl、Kaufland）與 Google 合作，透過 STACKIT 為 57.5 萬名員工部署主權版 Google Workspace。

overview.en: Schwarz Group, Europe's largest retailer owning Lidl and Kaufland with 575,000 employees, signed a partnership with Google in November 2024 to deploy Google Workspace with client-side encryption. Schwarz Digits' cloud platform STACKIT hosts the Google Workspace data within the EU, ensuring full data sovereignty. Company data is encrypted such that even Google cannot access it, addressing European regulatory requirements.
overview.zh: 旗下擁有 Lidl 與 Kaufland、員工達 57.5 萬人的歐洲最大零售商 Schwarz Group，於 2024 年 11 月與 Google 簽署合作協議，部署具備用戶端加密的 Google Workspace。Schwarz Digits 旗下的雲端平台 STACKIT 將 Google Workspace 資料存儲於歐盟境內，確保完全的資料主權——即便 Google 本身也無法存取相關資料，符合歐洲監管要求。

en: Transitioning 575,000 employees to Google Workspace with full data sovereignty.
STACKIT cloud platform hosts data within the EU with client-side encryption inaccessible even to Google.
Partnership announced November 2024 to enhance workplace productivity and data security.
Addresses European data sovereignty requirements for the retail sector.
zh: 將 57.5 萬名員工遷移至具完整資料主權的 Google Workspace。
STACKIT 雲端平台將資料存儲於歐盟境內，採用連 Google 都無法存取的用戶端加密。
2024 年 11 月宣布合作，以強化工作效率與資料安全。
滿足零售業的歐洲資料主權要求。

en: Reduced email writing time by 30–35% using Gemini in Google Workspace.
Resulted in faster customer response times and higher team morale.
Improved the quality of customer interactions across the sports retail business.
zh: 使用 Google Workspace 中的 Gemini，將撰寫郵件時間縮短 30 至 35%。
帶來更快的顧客回應速度與更高的團隊士氣。
提升運動零售業顧客互動的整體品質。

summary.en: Swarovski migrated 1,000+ data objects to BigQuery and launched the Génie gen AI portal on Vertex AI for 1,000+ employees, achieving 17% higher email open rates.
summary.zh: Swarovski 將逾 1,000 個資料物件遷移至 BigQuery，並在 Vertex AI 上推出供逾千名員工使用的 Génie 生成式 AI 入口網站，郵件開信率提升 17%。

overview.en: Swarovski, the 130-year-old luxury brand operating across 140+ markets, modernized its data foundation by migrating over 1,000 data objects from 30+ sources to a BigQuery-based Data Lakehouse. The company then launched Génie, a generative AI portal powered by Vertex AI and Gemini, used by over 1,000 employees for contract review, content translation (20+ languages), creative asset generation, and campaign planning. AI personalization delivered measurable marketing results, and campaign localization was accelerated dramatically.
overview.zh: 跨越 140 個市場、擁有 130 年歷史的奢侈品牌 Swarovski，將逾 30 個來源的 1,000 多個資料物件遷移至以 BigQuery 為核心的資料湖倉，現代化其資料基礎。隨後推出以 Vertex AI 及 Gemini 驅動的生成式 AI 入口網站 Génie，供逾千名員工用於合約審查、內容翻譯（超過 20 種語言）、創意資產生成及行銷活動規劃。AI 個人化帶來可量化的行銷成果，行銷活動在地化速度大幅提升。

en: Migrated 1,000+ data objects from 30+ sources to a BigQuery Data Lakehouse.
Génie gen AI portal on Vertex AI used by 1,000+ employees for creative and business tasks.
Achieved 17% higher email open rates and 7% higher click-through rates through AI personalization.
Accelerated campaign localization by 10x using generative AI.
zh: 將逾 30 個來源的 1,000 多個資料物件遷移至 BigQuery 資料湖倉。
Vertex AI 上的 Génie 生成式 AI 入口網站供逾千名員工用於創意與業務任務。
透過 AI 個人化，電子郵件開信率提升 17%、點閱率提升 7%。
以生成式 AI 將行銷活動在地化速度加快 10 倍。

summary.en: Trace One uses Vertex AI to automatically extract information from complex product documents, creating up-to-date summaries for retail and CPG customers.
summary.zh: Trace One 利用 Vertex AI 自動從複雜商品文件中擷取資訊，為零售與消費品客戶生成最新摘要。

overview.en: Trace One is a global product lifecycle management (PLM) provider for retail and consumer packaged goods companies. The company uses Vertex AI to automatically extract information from complex documents such as datasheets, product specifications, and regulatory filings to create up-to-date product summaries and data sheets. This covers various industry and regulatory standards, reducing manual data entry and improving accuracy for their retail and CPG customers.
overview.zh: Trace One 是零售與消費品公司的全球商品生命週期管理（PLM）供應商，使用 Vertex AI 從技術規格書、商品規格及法規文件等複雜文件中自動擷取資訊，生成最新的商品摘要與資料表，涵蓋各種業界與監管標準，為零售及消費品客戶減少手動資料輸入並提升準確性。

en: Automates extraction of information from complex datasheets and regulatory documents using Vertex AI.
Creates up-to-date product summaries and data sheets covering multiple industry standards.
Reduces manual data entry and improves accuracy for retail and CPG lifecycle management.
Explores additional AI use cases including product recipe optimization and formulation suggestions.
zh: 利用 Vertex AI 自動從複雜技術規格書與法規文件中擷取資訊。
生成涵蓋多種業界標準的最新商品摘要與資料表。
減少零售及消費品生命週期管理中的手動資料輸入並提升準確性。
探索其他 AI 應用場景，包括商品配方優化與調配建議。

summary.en: TRIAL Company migrated 300+ supercenters' legacy systems to Google Cloud in under an hour, avoiding a full day of projected downtime.

overview.en: TRIAL Company, a Japanese retailer operating over 300 supercenters, migrated legacy on-premises systems to Google Cloud using Hybrid Subnets and Migrate to Virtual Machines without changing IP addresses. This approach avoided a projected full day of downtime. The cutover was completed in under an hour, improving infrastructure stability and establishing a foundation for future cloud-native modernization.
overview.zh: 經營逾 300 家超市的日本零售商 TRIAL Company，使用 Hybrid Subnets 及 Migrate to Virtual Machines 在不更改 IP 位址的情況下，將傳統本地系統遷移至 Google Cloud。此方案避免了預計長達一整天的服務中斷，整個切換過程在不到一小時內完成，提升基礎設施穩定性並奠定未來雲端原生現代化的基礎。

en: Migrated legacy on-premises systems for 300+ supercenters to Google Cloud in under an hour.
Avoided a projected full day of downtime by not changing IP addresses during migration.
Used Hybrid Subnets and Migrate to Virtual Machines for seamless cutover.
Established a foundation for future cloud-native modernization of retail operations.
zh: 在不到一小時內完成逾 300 家超市傳統本地系統的 Google Cloud 遷移。
遷移過程中不更改 IP 位址，避免了預計長達一整天的服務中斷。
使用 Hybrid Subnets 及 Migrate to Virtual Machines 實現無縫切換。
為零售營運的未來雲端原生現代化奠定基礎。
